title: Tunisian Roasted Chestnut Tagine
description: A traditional Tunisian dish made with roasted chestnuts, perfect for a gluten-free dinner. This tagine is a hearty and flavorful stew that's perfect for a cold winter night.
instructions: Peel and chop the chestnuts into large pieces.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the chopped chestnuts, chicken broth, dried apricots, almonds, cinnamon, cumin, and salt to the pot.
Bring to a boil, then cover and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 30-40 minutes, or until the chestnuts are tender.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
Note: Traditionally, a tagine is cooked in a clay pot with a conical lid. If you have one, use it! If not, a Dutch oven will work just fine.
This recipe can be made ahead and refrigerated or frozen for later use.
